# Resource provenance

The public pack contains Erosion Sector owned block models/textures only. Minecraft/Create/Copycats+/Create Deco original assets are not included. Those assets are read from a local, user-provided .esresources archive and kept in browser storage without upload.

Copycats defaults and the material_data test fixture describe the installed 3.0.9 state/serialization format, not a material-combination export table.
